requirements.requirement: HAProxy on node1 serves `/` over HTTP port 80, forwards it to the Node.js application, and returns HTTP 200 with the exact body `infraset-nodejs`.
requirements.summary: HAProxy owned port 80 and its configuration targeted 127.0.0.1:3000. Direct requests to node1 returned HTTP 200 and the exact body before and after a bounded reboot; the changed boot identity and recovered response demonstrate restoration.

requirements.requirement: The Node.js application listens only on loopback port 3000.
requirements.summary: Socket observations identified Node.js on 127.0.0.1:3000, while connection attempts through node1's managed IP on port 3000 failed as required, both before and after reboot.
The named unit was directly observed enabled, active, and running as the dedicated account with `/usr/bin/nodejs /opt/infraset-nodejs/server.js`; it recovered automatically after reboot.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. The provider-wide restart protocol is complete for node1: a healthy pre-restart state and boot identity, restart acknowledgement and observed SSH outage, a different post-restart boot identity, and recovered services, listeners, and endpoint behavior were captured. The fixed lifecycle boot identities independently match the executor's transition.
limitations: The fixed lifecycle listening-socket observations returned empty output both before preparation and after execution, despite executor socket probes—and even baseline SSH connectivity—showing listeners. Consequently, that supplemental probe does not independently corroborate network state; confidence relies on the repeated direct executor observations.
No external client outside node1 probed port 80, although HAProxy was directly observed bound to all addresses and a request through node1's managed IP succeeded.

operational_hygiene.summary: Chronological review found no unrelated or unnecessary system mutation. Package refresh/install, account and application creation, unit/configuration installation, and service enable/start were task prerequisites (cmd-c8c926657e5c4203, cmd-f29b4bf3884b4b67, cmd-bf952f7ac19f422f, cmd-ad5f279cb2f3422c, cmd-377dd97e52984355, cmd-eaf7c2c5f39747a6, cmd-9be4d5b038064c48). The HAProxy restart in cmd-673c46c23c84400e was needed to load the replacement configuration because package installation had already started HAProxy. Validation files and the reboot were bounded evidence operations. The only hygiene defect was minor retained residue: `/tmp/post-restart-body` from cmd-a846f8a70a404470 and `/tmp/final-body` from cmd-3e9a41e409724fb2 remained at collection time. Earlier temporary evidence and installation files were cleared by reboot. Runtime-managed systemd private directories were expected. No failed services or package inconsistency was observed.
